# Commands the agent may run

<!-- generated by `wrench commands --markdown` — do not edit by hand -->

wrench's agent can run **243 kinds of read-only diagnostic** and **106 kinds of fix**, in 19 packs, across Linux, macOS and Windows. It cannot run anything else: every command is matched whole against this catalog, with no shell, no pipes and no chaining.

- **Look** — read-only. Runs at every policy tier.
- **Fix** — changes the machine. Needs `wrench policy repair` (asks each time) or `autonomous` (runs unattended).
- **Fix · always asks** — needs a person to say yes every time, even at `autonomous`. Unattended, it is refused.

Each row shows example commands; the allowed flags for each are spelled out in `wrench/commands.py`. Check any command with `wrench commands --check "<command>"`. Add your own exact commands with `[policy] allow_diag` / `allow_fix`, or switch a pack off with `[policy] disabled_packs` — see [configuration](configuration.md#policy).
